author: @markys99
text: Oh my good.... I can't explain the emotion I'm feeling right now. This is the first time I've commented since the MV came out, and after watching the Debut Show, I finally plucked up the courage to say what I think. This here is inexplicable, it's incredible, legendary, beautiful, and countless other adjectives! It's pure art! I was so worried about the debut, but it looks like this time they got it right. Zb1 made an incredible, iconic debut. It's all my favorite style. From the MV to the music. The album is magnificent, fantastic. I cried countless times while watching the MV the first few times. My head was pounding "is this really happening? Is Zb1 really and FINALLY debuting? And best of all, with a concept we all wanted?" OMG---- I cried because I was emotional, proud. I saw what these boys went through, we all saw it. It wasn't easy, not for them, and not for us. Luckily we were able to make their dreams come true, and my god, that makes me so, so happy. The lyrics of the song also made me cry a lot, especially when "Nothing lasts forever". This lyric reminded me that we only have two years and six months with them :( So Zeroses, let's make these two years the best! I'm so happy it's inexplicable, I just feel it. I'm so proud of them, omg :( This is the first of many posts I'll be doing about why I'm thrilled and happy about Zb1's debut. It's just the first post. Anyway, I'm so proud of the boys, they worked so hard :( Thanks to their effort, this was a success. It's amazing! Zb1! I love you all so much! You worked so hard, so proud!!!♡

text: Wow wow ! I genuinely like it a lot ! It suits them a lot, It feels new with the song structure and the verses melody being way less predictable than I thought they would be(because in a way I was afraid that it would feel a bit generic and forgettable, but it all sticks together nicely with the chorus and everything !) .
